dana: Quick postmortem follow-up: recurring autoscale churn during nightly bulk-ingest still hitting GPU headroom. We agreed on three parallel actions: quota soak, scheduler rollback/patch, and daytime smoke monitors. Posting owners + short targets here, please ack.

theo: I'll own the quota soak (RW-4700). Plan: request +12% quota for 5 days during canary window (2026-07-12 to 2026-07-17). Need cloud-ops approval + automated revert. Filing it now.

emma: I'll take the scheduler canary (RW-4701). My plan: test lowering preempt aggression and add burst_slot limits. Sample patch for staging: `kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -p '{"data":{"preempt_aggression":"0.5","burst_slots":"10"}}'` Canaried 48h, then reassess.

rachel: I'll add a smoke workflow and Grafana alert (RW-4702). Workflow path: `.github/workflows/gpu-headroom-smoke.yml`. Alert threshold: headroom_percent < 10% for 5m during 06:00-22:00 PT. Pager includes runbook link.

ops-bot: Linked postmortem https://redwood.app/pm/2187654000 and created follow-ups RW-4700, RW-4701, RW-4702.

dana: Consolidated targets: theo RW-4700 (quota soak) target 2026-07-20; emma RW-4701 (scheduler canary) target 2026-07-16; rachel RW-4702 (smoke + alert) target 2026-07-14. I'll run 10-min async check-ins Tue/Thu until closed.

theo: Metrics to capture during soak: `gpu_alloc_rate`, `headroom_percent_p10`, `eviction_count`, `queued_batches_p99`. I'll attach CSV to RW-4700.

emma: Noted. I'll also record `preempt_latency_p95` and `tail_latency_ms`. Will include rollback script: `kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -p '{"data":{"preempt_aggression":"0.8","burst_slots":"16"}}'`

rachel: Adding feature flag gate `feature.headroom_smoke` to make disabling quick in a noisy window. Pager runbook attached in RW-4702.

dana: Thanks. If anyone hits RBAC or cloud approval blockers, ping me directly. Acks please.

theo: Ack. Requesting cloud-ops now.

emma: Ack. Scheduling canary for 2026-07-13 staging window.

rachel: Ack ":thumbsup:" PR for smoke job shortly.
